edges.reason: changeOwner is executed under the onlyOwner modifier guard.
onlyOwner performs the require(msg.sender==owner) ownership check.
msg.sender is compared against the owner inside the access control check.
The stored owner state variable is read by the access control check.
changeOwner receives the _newOwner argument.
_newOwner is written into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership reads msg.sender to validate the caller.
acceptOwnership reads the pending newOwner value.
acceptOwnership writes the new value of owner.
balanceOf receives the _owner argument.
_owner is used as the lookup key in the balances mapping.
transfer receives the _to recipient argument.
transfer receives the _amount argument.
transfer uses msg.sender as the debit side of the transfer.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transfer performs unchecked balance subtraction and addition.
transferFrom receives the _from argument.
transferFrom receives the _to argument.
transferFrom receives the _amount argument.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender when checking allowance.
transferFrom updates the balances mapping.
transferFrom decreases the allowed mapping entry.
transferFrom performs unchecked balance and allowance arithmetic.
approve receives the _spender argument.
approve receives the _amount argument.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
approve writes into the allowed mapping.
allowance receives the _owner argument.
allowance receives the _spender argument.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
The constructor sets the symbol state variable.
The constructor sets the name state variable.
The constructor sets the decimals state variable.
The constructor writes the totalSupply state variable.
The constructor computes 7711000000*10**18 without overflow protection.
The constructor uses msg.sender as the initial owner.
The constructor assigns owner.
The constructor mints the full supply into balances[owner].
receive forwards the received value through an external transfer to owner.
The external call target is the owner address state variable.
